topic: Your body replaces itself completely every 7 years — every cell, gone
hook: You are not the same person you were 7 years ago.
script: You are not the same person you were 7 years ago. Literally. Your body replaces almost every cell within 7 years. Skin cells every 2 weeks. Red blood cells every 4 months. Even bone cells regenerate every decade. The you from a decade ago is biologically gone. Only neurons persist. You are a ship of Theseus. Follow for facts that make you question everything.
